description.value: Opened in 2023, the Aberdeen Tiny Library is only 352 square feet — the smallest branch in the Thompson-Nicola Regional Library system — and is located inside a mall on the Trans-Canada Highway in southwest Kamloops. It is the first new library location in Kamloops since 1974, serving a rapidly growing part of the city. A touring cyclist passing through can access free Wi-Fi and library resources in a wheelchair-accessible, climate-controlled space.
